map.→ 打开拍频（f_beat = |f₁ − f₂|）工具: -> Open the beat frequency (f_beat = |f1 - f2|) tool
map.不能，拍频等于两频率之差的绝对值，必然小于其中较高的频率。: No. The beat frequency equals the absolute difference of the two frequencies, so it is always below the higher one.
map.两个不相干声源的总声级: Total sound level of two uncorrelated sources
map.两个相近频率叠加产生拍，拍频为二者之差。: Two close frequencies superposing produce beats, with the beat frequency equal to their difference.
map.两个频率相近的声波叠加，合成振幅按差值频率周期性起伏，人耳听到响度的周期性涨落就: When two sound waves of similar frequency superpose, the combined amplitude undulates at the difference frequency, and the periodic rise and fall in loudness heard by the ear is the beat.
map.吉他或提琴调音时，听两弦差值产生的拍来对齐频率。: When tuning a guitar or violin, listen to the beats produced by the difference of two strings to align the pitch.
map.拍频能超过两频率吗？: Can the beat frequency exceed either of the two frequencies?
map.拍频计算器，输入两个相近频率 f₁、f₂，按拍频=|f₁−f₂| 求叠加产生的振: Beat frequency calculator: enter two close frequencies f1 and f2 and get the frequency of the periodic amplitude undulation from their superposition as beat = |f1 - f2|, for tuning and interference analysis.
map.校准音叉或发生器时观察拍消失点。: Watch for the point where the beats disappear when calibrating a tuning fork or generator.
map.直达声与混响声相等的临界距离: Critical distance where direct sound equals reverberant sound
map.示波器/音频中判断两个相近频率的干涉。: Judge interference between two close frequencies on an oscilloscope or in audio.
map.：两把音叉频率 f1=440 Hz、f2=444 Hz，拍频 f_beat=|f: : for two forks at f1 = 440 Hz and f2 = 444 Hz, the beat frequency f_beat = |f1 - f2| = 4 Hz, so four loud-soft cycles per second; as the two frequencies converge the beat approaches 0.
